headline.en: Accept failures include the operating-system error
headline.fr: Les échecs accept incluent l’erreur système
headline.zh: accept 失败包含操作系统错误
headline.ru: Ошибки accept включают OS error

what_changed.en: Async and threaded HTTP server accept loops request raw errno from TNetSocketWrap.Accept and add SystemErrorShort to debug logging; banned-address checks run only after success.
what_changed.fr: Les boucles accept async et threadées récupèrent errno brut et ajoutent SystemErrorShort aux logs ; la blacklist n’est testée qu’après succès.
what_changed.zh: 异步与 thread HTTP server 的 accept loop 获取原始 errno 并在 debug 日志加入 SystemErrorShort；仅在成功后检查 banned address。
what_changed.ru: Async и threaded HTTP server accept loops получают raw errno и добавляют SystemErrorShort в debug logs; banned-address check выполняется только после успеха.

impact.en: Operators receive actionable accept diagnostics without a public behavior change. Failed accepts no longer feed an uninitialized peer address to the ban check.
impact.fr: Les opérateurs obtiennent un diagnostic utile sans changement public. Un accept en échec ne passe plus une adresse non initialisée à la blacklist.
impact.zh: 运维人员获得可操作的 accept 诊断，公开行为不变；失败 accept 不再把未初始化 peer address 传给 ban 检查。
impact.ru: Operators получают полезную диагностику accept без публичного изменения. Failed accept больше не передаёт uninitialized peer address в ban check.

headline.en: Tunnel failures retain their socket context
headline.fr: Les échecs Tunnel conservent leur contexte socket
headline.zh: Tunnel 失败保留 socket 上下文
headline.ru: Tunnel failures сохраняют socket context

what_changed.en: TTunnelLocalThread includes the raw accept error in exceptions, and TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal logs the failing class, message, thread and socket before cleanup.
what_changed.fr: TTunnelLocalThread inclut l’erreur accept brute, et TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal logue classe, message, thread et socket avant nettoyage.
what_changed.zh: TTunnelLocalThread 在异常中包含原始 accept 错误，TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal 在清理前记录失败 class、message、thread 与 socket。
what_changed.ru: TTunnelLocalThread включает raw accept error в exception, а TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal логирует class, message, thread и socket до cleanup.

impact.en: Tunnel connection failures become diagnosable and still close the partial socket. Protocol behavior and public signatures are unchanged.
impact.fr: Les échecs Tunnel deviennent diagnostiquables et ferment toujours la socket partielle. Le protocole et les signatures ne changent pas.
impact.zh: Tunnel 连接失败现在可诊断，且仍会关闭部分创建的 socket；协议行为与公开 signature 不变。
impact.ru: Tunnel connection failures становятся диагностируемыми и по-прежнему закрывают partial socket. Протокол и публичные signatures не меняются.

headline.en: AArch64 alignment and Tunnel cleanup receive follow-up fixes
headline.fr: L’alignement AArch64 et le nettoyage Tunnel reçoivent des correctifs
headline.zh: AArch64 对齐与 Tunnel 清理获得后续修复
headline.ru: AArch64 alignment и Tunnel cleanup получают follow-up fixes

what_changed.en: GlobalTime assertions allow padding after unpacking, Delphi POSIX resource comments are clarified, and TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal initializes thread before exception logging and reports the socket consistently.
what_changed.fr: Les assertions GlobalTime tolèrent le padding, les commentaires resource sont clarifiés et TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal initialise thread avant les exceptions.
what_changed.zh: GlobalTime assertion 允许 unpack 后的 padding，Delphi POSIX resource 注释更明确，TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal 在异常日志前初始化 thread 并一致报告 socket。
what_changed.ru: Assertions GlobalTime допускают padding, comments ресурсов уточнены, а TTunnelLocal.OpenInternal инициализирует thread до exception logging и последовательно сообщает socket.

impact.en: This removes a startup assertion risk on Delphi AArch64 and prevents undefined diagnostic values if Tunnel setup fails before thread creation.
impact.fr: Cela supprime un risque d’assertion au démarrage Delphi AArch64 et évite des diagnostics indéfinis si Tunnel échoue avant la création du thread.
impact.zh: 这消除 Delphi AArch64 启动 assertion 风险，并避免 Tunnel 在线程创建前失败时出现未定义诊断值。
impact.ru: Это убирает startup assertion risk на Delphi AArch64 и undefined diagnostics при сбое Tunnel до создания thread.

action_detail.en: Upgrade to build 2.4.17002 and exercise this corrected path on every affected Delphi/FPC target before deployment.
action_detail.fr: Passez à la build 2.4.17002 et testez ce chemin corrigé sur chaque cible Delphi/FPC concernée avant déploiement.
action_detail.zh: 升级到 build 2.4.17002，并在部署前于每个受影响的 Delphi/FPC target 上测试此修复路径。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь до build 2.4.17002 и до развёртывания проверьте исправленный путь на каждой затронутой Delphi/FPC target.

headline.en: AArch64 follow-up only adjusts style and inlining
headline.fr: Le suivi AArch64 ne change que style et inline
headline.zh: AArch64 后续仅调整样式与 inline
headline.ru: AArch64 follow-up меняет только стиль и inline

what_changed.en: The commit fixes indentation, marks AAPCS64 va_list helpers inline, and updates the changelog wording for Delphi 13.1 platform support.
what_changed.fr: Le commit corrige l’indentation, marque les helpers va_list AAPCS64 inline et ajuste le changelog Delphi 13.1.
what_changed.zh: 该 commit 修正缩进，把 AAPCS64 va_list helper 标记为 inline，并更新 Delphi 13.1 平台支持 changelog。
what_changed.ru: Commit исправляет indentation, помечает AAPCS64 va_list helpers inline и обновляет changelog по Delphi 13.1.

impact.en: There is no functional application impact; Delphi/FPC behavior and public APIs remain the same.
impact.fr: Il n’y a aucun impact fonctionnel ; le comportement Delphi/FPC et les API restent identiques.
impact.zh: 应用无功能影响；Delphi/FPC 行为与公开 API 保持不变。
impact.ru: Функционального влияния на приложения нет; поведение Delphi/FPC и публичные API не меняются.

headline.en: The platform MSG_NOSIGNAL value becomes public
headline.fr: La valeur MSG_NOSIGNAL de la plateforme devient publique
headline.zh: 平台 MSG_NOSIGNAL 值成为公开变量
headline.ru: Platform MSG_NOSIGNAL становится публичным

what_changed.en: mormot.net.sock initializes the public NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL variable from the platform constant for reuse by higher-level socket and TLS code.
what_changed.fr: mormot.net.sock initialise la variable publique NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL depuis la constante plateforme pour le code socket/TLS supérieur.
what_changed.zh: mormot.net.sock 用平台常量初始化公开变量 NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL，供上层 socket 与 TLS 代码复用。
what_changed.ru: mormot.net.sock инициализирует публичную переменную NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL из platform constant для higher-level socket и TLS кода.

impact.en: Existing applications are unaffected; low-level integrations can query the effective flag without duplicating platform conditionals.
impact.fr: Les applications existantes ne changent pas ; les intégrations bas niveau peuvent lire le flag sans dupliquer les conditionnels.
impact.zh: 现有应用不受影响；底层集成可读取有效 flag，无需重复平台条件编译。
impact.ru: Существующие приложения не затронуты; low-level integrations могут читать effective flag без дублирования platform conditionals.

note.en: Runtime copy of the platform MSG_NOSIGNAL value.
note.fr: Copie runtime de la valeur MSG_NOSIGNAL plateforme.
note.zh: 平台 MSG_NOSIGNAL 值的 runtime 副本。

headline.en: OpenSSL 4 suppresses SIGPIPE per socket
headline.fr: OpenSSL 4 supprime SIGPIPE par socket
headline.zh: OpenSSL 4 按 socket 抑制 SIGPIPE
headline.ru: OpenSSL 4 подавляет SIGPIPE для каждого socket

what_changed.en: SSLSetFdNoSigPipe uses BIO_C_SET_SEND_FLAGS with NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL on OpenSSL 4+, falling back to process-wide SigPipeIntercept for OpenSSL 1.1/3.x.
what_changed.fr: SSLSetFdNoSigPipe utilise BIO_C_SET_SEND_FLAGS avec NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL sous OpenSSL 4+, avec fallback SigPipeIntercept pour OpenSSL 1.1/3.x.
what_changed.zh: SSLSetFdNoSigPipe 在 OpenSSL 4+ 使用 BIO_C_SET_SEND_FLAGS 与 NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL，在 OpenSSL 1.1/3.x 回退到进程级 SigPipeIntercept。
what_changed.ru: SSLSetFdNoSigPipe использует BIO_C_SET_SEND_FLAGS с NET_MSG_NOSIGNAL на OpenSSL 4+, сохраняя process-wide SigPipeIntercept для OpenSSL 1.1/3.x.

impact.en: POSIX applications on OpenSSL 4 avoid changing SIGPIPE handling for the whole process. Older OpenSSL versions retain the historical behavior unless explicitly disabled.
impact.fr: Les applications POSIX avec OpenSSL 4 ne changent plus SIGPIPE pour tout le processus. Les anciennes versions gardent le comportement historique.
impact.zh: 使用 OpenSSL 4 的 POSIX 应用不再修改整个进程的 SIGPIPE 处理；旧版 OpenSSL 仍保持历史行为。
impact.ru: POSIX-приложения с OpenSSL 4 больше не меняют SIGPIPE handling всего процесса. Старые OpenSSL сохраняют историческое поведение.

headline.en: MSG_NOSIGNAL constants are corrected across POSIX systems
headline.fr: Les constantes MSG_NOSIGNAL sont corrigées sur les systèmes POSIX
headline.zh: 各 POSIX 系统的 MSG_NOSIGNAL 常量已修正
headline.ru: MSG_NOSIGNAL constants исправлены для POSIX systems

what_changed.en: mormot.net.sock.posix corrects MSG_NOSIGNAL values for Darwin, FreeBSD, NetBSD, DragonFlyBSD, OpenBSD and Solaris, while retaining Linux and Android values.
what_changed.fr: mormot.net.sock.posix corrige MSG_NOSIGNAL pour Darwin, FreeBSD, NetBSD, DragonFlyBSD, OpenBSD et Solaris, sans changer Linux/Android.
what_changed.zh: mormot.net.sock.posix 修正 Darwin、FreeBSD、NetBSD、DragonFlyBSD、OpenBSD 与 Solaris 的 MSG_NOSIGNAL 值，保留 Linux/Android 值。
what_changed.ru: mormot.net.sock.posix исправляет MSG_NOSIGNAL для Darwin, FreeBSD, NetBSD, DragonFlyBSD, OpenBSD и Solaris, сохраняя Linux/Android.

impact.en: Socket sends on affected BSD/Solaris targets now request the intended no-SIGPIPE behavior instead of passing a wrong flag value.
impact.fr: Les envois socket sur BSD/Solaris demandent maintenant le bon comportement no-SIGPIPE au lieu d’un flag incorrect.
impact.zh: 受影响 BSD/Solaris target 的 socket send 现在会请求正确的 no-SIGPIPE 行为，不再传入错误 flag。
impact.ru: Socket sends на затронутых BSD/Solaris targets теперь запрашивают правильный no-SIGPIPE вместо неверного flag.

action_detail.en: Upgrade to build 2.4.17002 and exercise this corrected path on every affected Delphi/FPC target before deployment.
action_detail.fr: Passez à la build 2.4.17002 et testez ce chemin corrigé sur chaque cible Delphi/FPC concernée avant déploiement.
action_detail.zh: 升级到 build 2.4.17002，并在部署前于每个受影响的 Delphi/FPC target 上测试此修复路径。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь до build 2.4.17002 и до развёртывания проверьте исправленный путь на каждой затронутой Delphi/FPC target.

headline.en: Absolute XML lookups intentionally move the parser
headline.fr: Les recherches XML absolues déplacent volontairement le parser
headline.zh: 绝对 XML 查询会有意移动 parser
headline.ru: Абсолютный XML lookup намеренно перемещает parser

what_changed.en: TXmlParser.GetU returns false for nil paths, preserves position for relative and // paths, but lets an absolute / path rewind and remain at the found position; GetI inherits this behavior.
what_changed.fr: TXmlParser.GetU renvoie false pour nil, préserve la position pour les chemins relatifs et //, mais un chemin / absolu rewind et reste au résultat ; GetI suit ce comportement.
what_changed.zh: TXmlParser.GetU 对 nil path 返回 false；相对 path 与 // path 保持位置，但绝对 / path 会 rewind 并停留在结果位置；GetI 继承该行为。
what_changed.ru: TXmlParser.GetU возвращает false для nil, сохраняет position для relative и // paths, но absolute / path делает rewind и остаётся на найденной позиции; GetI наследует поведение.

impact.en: Code that expected GetU('/...') or GetI('/...') to restore the prior forward-only parser position will now observe a changed cursor and should review its sequence.
impact.fr: Le code qui attendait une restauration après GetU('/...') ou GetI('/...') observe maintenant un curseur déplacé et doit revoir sa séquence.
impact.zh: 原本期望 GetU('/...') 或 GetI('/...') 恢复 forward-only parser 位置的代码现在会看到 cursor 改变，应检查调用顺序。
impact.ru: Код, ожидавший restore позиции после GetU('/...') или GetI('/...'), теперь увидит изменённый cursor и должен проверить последовательность.

action_detail.en: Search for absolute-path GetU/GetI calls and use Save/Restore explicitly if the previous position must survive.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez les GetU/GetI avec chemin absolu et utilisez Save/Restore si la position doit survivre.
action_detail.zh: 搜索使用绝对 path 的 GetU/GetI；若需保留原位置，请显式使用 Save/Restore。
action_detail.ru: Найдите GetU/GetI с absolute path и используйте Save/Restore, если прежняя position должна сохраниться.

note.en: Absolute paths now leave the parser at the result.
note.fr: Les chemins absolus laissent le parser au résultat.
note.zh: 绝对 path 现在让 parser 停留在结果位置。
note.ru: Absolute paths теперь оставляют parser на результате.

headline.en: BSD socket constants match their native headers
headline.fr: Les constantes socket BSD correspondent aux headers natifs
headline.zh: BSD socket 常量与原生 header 对齐
headline.ru: BSD socket constants соответствуют native headers

what_changed.en: POSIX definitions correct NI_NUMERIC*, poll write flags, FreeBSD TCP keepalive values, Darwin-only cellular interface handling and ARPOP_InREPLY.
what_changed.fr: Les définitions POSIX corrigent NI_NUMERIC*, les flags poll write, le keepalive FreeBSD, l’interface cellulaire Darwin et ARPOP_InREPLY.
what_changed.zh: POSIX 定义修正 NI_NUMERIC*、poll 写 flag、FreeBSD TCP keepalive、仅 Darwin 的 cellular interface 处理与 ARPOP_InREPLY。
what_changed.ru: POSIX definitions исправляют NI_NUMERIC*, poll write flags, FreeBSD TCP keepalive, Darwin-only cellular interface и ARPOP_InREPLY.

impact.en: FreeBSD, NetBSD, DragonFlyBSD, OpenBSD, Darwin and Solaris networking uses the intended native option numbers instead of Linux-biased values.
impact.fr: Le réseau FreeBSD, NetBSD, DragonFlyBSD, OpenBSD, Darwin et Solaris utilise les bons numéros natifs au lieu de valeurs orientées Linux.
impact.zh: FreeBSD、NetBSD、DragonFlyBSD、OpenBSD、Darwin 与 Solaris 网络现在使用正确原生选项号，不再偏向 Linux 值。
impact.ru: Networking FreeBSD, NetBSD, DragonFlyBSD, OpenBSD, Darwin и Solaris использует правильные native option numbers вместо Linux-biased значений.

action_detail.en: Upgrade to build 2.4.17002 and exercise this corrected path on every affected Delphi/FPC target before deployment.
action_detail.fr: Passez à la build 2.4.17002 et testez ce chemin corrigé sur chaque cible Delphi/FPC concernée avant déploiement.
action_detail.zh: 升级到 build 2.4.17002，并在部署前于每个受影响的 Delphi/FPC target 上测试此修复路径。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь до build 2.4.17002 и до развёртывания проверьте исправленный путь на каждой затронутой Delphi/FPC target.

headline.en: Bounded UTF-8 formatting stops parsing once full
headline.fr: Le formatage UTF-8 borné arrête le parsing une fois plein
headline.zh: 有界 UTF-8 格式化在填满后停止解析
headline.ru: Bounded UTF-8 formatting прекращает parsing после заполнения

what_changed.en: TFormatUtf8.InitParse receives MaxSize and stops collecting format blocks once that limit is reached; FormatBufferRaw and FormatShort pass their real capacities.
what_changed.fr: TFormatUtf8.InitParse reçoit MaxSize et arrête de collecter les blocs une fois la limite atteinte ; FormatBufferRaw et FormatShort passent leur capacité réelle.
what_changed.zh: TFormatUtf8.InitParse 接收 MaxSize，并在达到限制后停止收集格式块；FormatBufferRaw 与 FormatShort 传入真实容量。
what_changed.ru: TFormatUtf8.InitParse получает MaxSize и прекращает сбор format blocks при достижении лимита; FormatBufferRaw и FormatShort передают реальную ёмкость.

impact.en: Truncated formatting avoids converting unused later arguments, reducing work for fixed buffers while keeping the same bounded output.
impact.fr: Le formatage tronqué évite de convertir les arguments ultérieurs inutiles, réduisant le travail avec la même sortie bornée.
impact.zh: 截断格式化不再转换后续无用参数，在保持相同有界输出的同时减少工作量。
impact.ru: Truncated formatting не преобразует ненужные поздние arguments, снижая работу при том же bounded output.

headline.en: Format arguments can be scanned for object rendering
headline.fr: Les arguments de format peuvent être testés pour le rendu d’objets
headline.zh: 可扫描格式参数是否需要对象渲染
headline.ru: Format arguments можно проверить на object rendering

what_changed.en: mormot.core.text adds VarRecHasObject to detect vtObject or vtInterface values that require TTextWriter.WriteObject instead of the fast formatter.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.text ajoute VarRecHasObject pour détecter vtObject/vtInterface nécessitant TTextWriter.WriteObject.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.text 新增 VarRecHasObject，用于检测需要 TTextWriter.WriteObject 的 vtObject 或 vtInterface 值。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.text добавляет VarRecHasObject для обнаружения vtObject/vtInterface, требующих TTextWriter.WriteObject.

impact.en: The helper supports later logging optimization and does not alter existing application behavior. Its name is changed to VarRecNeedsWriteObject later in the same batch.
impact.fr: Le helper prépare l’optimisation des logs sans changer les applications. Il est renommé VarRecNeedsWriteObject plus tard dans la série.
impact.zh: 该 helper 支持后续日志优化，不改变现有应用行为；同一批次稍后改名为 VarRecNeedsWriteObject。
impact.ru: Helper поддерживает последующую оптимизацию логов и не меняет приложения. Позже в этой серии он переименован в VarRecNeedsWriteObject.

headline.en: Control characters can be replaced in place
headline.fr: Les caractères de contrôle peuvent être remplacés sur place
headline.zh: 控制字符可原地替换
headline.ru: Управляющие символы можно заменить in-place

what_changed.en: mormot.core.unicode adds TrimControlCharsBuffer, replacing bytes #0 through #31 with spaces directly in a supplied UTF-8 buffer.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.unicode ajoute TrimControlCharsBuffer, remplaçant les octets #0 à #31 par des espaces directement dans le buffer UTF-8.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.unicode 新增 TrimControlCharsBuffer，直接在传入 UTF-8 buffer 中把 #0 到 #31 字节替换为空格。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.unicode добавляет TrimControlCharsBuffer, заменяющий bytes #0..#31 пробелами прямо в UTF-8 buffer.

impact.en: Existing code is unchanged; Delphi/FPC callers gain an allocation-free helper used by the new TSynLog pre-rendering path.
impact.fr: Le code existant ne change pas ; les appelants gagnent un helper sans allocation utilisé par le nouveau pre-rendering TSynLog.
impact.zh: 现有代码不变；Delphi/FPC 调用方获得无分配 helper，并用于新的 TSynLog 预渲染路径。
impact.ru: Существующий код не меняется; Delphi/FPC получает allocation-free helper для нового TSynLog pre-rendering path.

note.en: Replaces ASCII control bytes with spaces in place.
note.fr: Remplace les contrôles ASCII par des espaces sur place.
note.zh: 原地把 ASCII 控制字节替换为空格。
note.ru: Заменяет ASCII control bytes пробелами in-place.

headline.en: The object-format probe receives its final name
headline.fr: Le test de format objet reçoit son nom final
headline.zh: 对象格式检测获得最终名称
headline.ru: Проверка object format получает финальное имя

what_changed.en: VarRecHasObject is renamed VarRecNeedsWriteObject with a byte-safe VType test, and TXmlParser comments document the absolute-path cursor behavior.
what_changed.fr: VarRecHasObject devient VarRecNeedsWriteObject avec un test VType byte-safe, et les commentaires TXmlParser documentent le curseur absolu.
what_changed.zh: VarRecHasObject 改名为 VarRecNeedsWriteObject，并使用 byte-safe VType 检查；TXmlParser 注释说明绝对 path 的 cursor 行为。
what_changed.ru: VarRecHasObject переименован в VarRecNeedsWriteObject с byte-safe проверкой VType; comments TXmlParser описывают cursor для absolute path.

impact.en: Only code written against the immediately preceding intermediate helper name must rename it; pre-existing applications have no migration.
impact.fr: Seul le code écrit contre le nom intermédiaire doit le renommer ; les applications antérieures n’ont aucune migration.
impact.zh: 仅使用前一中间 helper 名称的代码需要改名；更早的现有应用无需迁移。
impact.ru: Только код на промежуточном имени helper должен его заменить; ранее существующие приложения не требуют migration.

headline.en: Formatted TSynLog APIs now take RawUtf8
headline.fr: Les API TSynLog formatées prennent maintenant RawUtf8
headline.zh: 格式化 TSynLog API 改为接收 RawUtf8
headline.ru: Formatted APIs TSynLog теперь принимают RawUtf8

what_changed.en: TSynLogProc, TSynLog.Log, TSynLog.DoLog and their internal formatter change the format parameter from PUtf8Char to const RawUtf8.
what_changed.fr: TSynLogProc, TSynLog.Log, TSynLog.DoLog et leur formatter interne remplacent PUtf8Char par const RawUtf8.
what_changed.zh: TSynLogProc、TSynLog.Log、TSynLog.DoLog 及内部 formatter 把格式参数从 PUtf8Char 改为 const RawUtf8。
what_changed.ru: TSynLogProc, TSynLog.Log, TSynLog.DoLog и internal formatter меняют format parameter с PUtf8Char на const RawUtf8.

impact.en: String literals usually remain source-compatible, but callback declarations, method variables and callers passing PUtf8Char no longer match and must adopt RawUtf8.
impact.fr: Les littéraux restent souvent compatibles, mais les callbacks, method variables et appels PUtf8Char doivent passer à RawUtf8.
impact.zh: 字符串 literal 通常仍兼容，但 callback declaration、method variable 与传入 PUtf8Char 的调用不再匹配，必须改用 RawUtf8。
impact.ru: String literals обычно совместимы, но callback declarations, method variables и вызовы с PUtf8Char больше не совпадают и должны перейти на RawUtf8.

action_detail.en: Search for TSynLogProc and logging callbacks with PUtf8Char format parameters; change them to const RawUtf8 and convert pointer-only call sites.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez TSynLogProc et les callbacks avec format PUtf8Char ; passez-les à const RawUtf8 et convertissez les appels par pointeur.
action_detail.zh: 搜索 TSynLogProc 与使用 PUtf8Char 格式参数的日志 callback；改为 const RawUtf8，并转换仅指针调用点。
action_detail.ru: Найдите TSynLogProc и logging callbacks с PUtf8Char format; замените на const RawUtf8 и преобразуйте pointer-only calls.

note.fr: Le paramètre Format est const RawUtf8.
note.zh: Format 参数改为 const RawUtf8。

note.en: Formatted overloads now accept const RawUtf8.
note.fr: Les overloads formatés acceptent const RawUtf8.
note.zh: 格式化 overload 现在接收 const RawUtf8。
note.ru: Formatted overloads теперь принимают const RawUtf8.

headline.en: Formatted log text is rendered before taking the lock
headline.fr: Le texte formaté du log est rendu avant le verrou
headline.zh: 格式化日志文本在加锁前完成渲染
headline.ru: Formatted log text рендерится до блокировки

what_changed.en: TSynLog pre-renders up to 4KB into a stack buffer outside the writer lock, trims control bytes, and adds TSynLogFamily.DirectRendering to opt back into in-lock rendering.
what_changed.fr: TSynLog pré-rend jusqu’à 4 Ko sur la stack hors du verrou, remplace les contrôles et ajoute TSynLogFamily.DirectRendering pour revenir au rendu sous verrou.
what_changed.zh: TSynLog 在 writer 锁外预渲染最多 4KB 到 stack buffer，清理控制字节，并新增 TSynLogFamily.DirectRendering 以恢复锁内渲染。
what_changed.ru: TSynLog pre-renders до 4KB в stack buffer вне writer lock, убирает control bytes и добавляет TSynLogFamily.DirectRendering для возврата к in-lock rendering.

impact.en: Multithreaded services reduce time spent in each logger lock. Object/interface arguments still take the slow path, and DirectRendering can preserve custom writer expectations.
impact.fr: Les services multithread réduisent le temps sous verrou. Les arguments object/interface gardent le slow path et DirectRendering préserve les writers personnalisés.
impact.zh: 多线程服务减少 logger 锁占用时间；object/interface 参数仍走慢路径，DirectRendering 可保留自定义 writer 预期。
impact.ru: Multithreaded services меньше держат logger lock. Object/interface arguments используют slow path, а DirectRendering сохраняет ожидания custom writer.

action_detail.en: Benchmark high-volume logging and enable DirectRendering if a custom writer depends on formatting while locked.
action_detail.fr: Benchmarkez les logs intensifs et activez DirectRendering si un writer personnalisé dépend du rendu sous verrou.
action_detail.zh: 对高吞吐日志进行 benchmark；若自定义 writer 依赖锁内格式化，请启用 DirectRendering。
action_detail.ru: Проведите benchmark интенсивного logging и включите DirectRendering, если custom writer зависит от formatting под lock.

note.en: Disables the new 4KB pre-rendering fast path.
note.fr: Désactive le nouveau fast path de pré-rendu 4 Ko.
note.zh: 禁用新的 4KB 预渲染快速路径。

headline.en: Formatted TSynLog.Enter overloads also move to RawUtf8
headline.fr: Les overloads formatés TSynLog.Enter passent aussi à RawUtf8
headline.zh: 格式化 TSynLog.Enter overload 同样改用 RawUtf8
headline.ru: Formatted overloads TSynLog.Enter также переходят на RawUtf8

what_changed.en: Formatted Enter, EnterLocal and ManualEnter overloads replace PUtf8Char with const RawUtf8 and share the 4KB pre-rendering path before acquiring the log lock.
what_changed.fr: Les overloads formatés Enter, EnterLocal et ManualEnter remplacent PUtf8Char par const RawUtf8 et partagent le pré-rendu 4 Ko.
what_changed.zh: 格式化 Enter、EnterLocal 与 ManualEnter overload 把 PUtf8Char 改为 const RawUtf8，并在获取日志锁前共用 4KB 预渲染路径。
what_changed.ru: Formatted overloads Enter, EnterLocal и ManualEnter меняют PUtf8Char на const RawUtf8 и используют общий 4KB pre-rendering до захвата log lock.

impact.en: Applications with typed PUtf8Char trace wrappers or matching overload variables will stop compiling; ordinary RawUtf8 and literal calls remain direct.
impact.fr: Les wrappers de trace typés PUtf8Char ou variables d’overload ne compilent plus ; les appels RawUtf8 et littéraux restent directs.
impact.zh: 使用 typed PUtf8Char trace wrapper 或匹配 overload variable 的应用将无法编译；普通 RawUtf8 与 literal 调用仍可直接使用。
impact.ru: Приложения с typed PUtf8Char trace wrappers или overload variables перестанут компилироваться; обычные RawUtf8 и literal calls остаются прямыми.

action_detail.en: Search formatted Enter, EnterLocal and ManualEnter wrappers for PUtf8Char and change their format values to RawUtf8.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez les wrappers formatés Enter, EnterLocal et ManualEnter en PUtf8Char et passez leurs formats à RawUtf8.
action_detail.zh: 搜索使用 PUtf8Char 的格式化 Enter、EnterLocal、ManualEnter wrapper，并把格式值改为 RawUtf8。
action_detail.ru: Найдите formatted wrappers Enter, EnterLocal и ManualEnter с PUtf8Char и замените format values на RawUtf8.

note.en: Formatted overloads now take const RawUtf8.
note.fr: Les overloads formatés prennent const RawUtf8.
note.zh: 格式化 overload 改为 const RawUtf8。

note.en: Formatted overload now takes const RawUtf8.
note.zh: 格式化 overload 改为 const RawUtf8。

headline.en: Instance text is precomputed with the formatted log line
headline.fr: Le texte d’instance est pré-calculé avec la ligne de log
headline.zh: 实例文本与格式化日志行一起预计算
headline.ru: Instance text предварительно вычисляется с log line

what_changed.en: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt now writes the instance class/pointer prefix into the same stack buffer outside the writer lock before formatting the message.
what_changed.fr: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt écrit maintenant le préfixe classe/pointeur de l’instance dans le même buffer stack avant le verrou.
what_changed.zh: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt 现在会在 writer 锁外把实例 class/pointer 前缀写入同一 stack buffer，再格式化消息。
what_changed.ru: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt теперь пишет prefix class/pointer instance в тот же stack buffer до writer lock, затем форматирует сообщение.

impact.en: Instance-heavy multithreaded logging shortens lock duration further, but this intermediate implementation miscalculates remaining buffer space and is repaired in build 2.4.17000.
impact.fr: Les logs multithread avec instance réduisent encore le verrou, mais cette version calcule mal l’espace restant et est réparée en 2.4.17000.
impact.zh: 大量实例的多线程日志进一步缩短锁时间，但此中间实现错误计算剩余 buffer 空间，到 build 2.4.17000 才修复。
impact.ru: Instance-heavy multithreaded logging ещё сокращает lock duration, но промежуточная реализация неверно считает remaining buffer и исправлена в build 2.4.17000.

headline.en: The log pre-render buffer can no longer overflow
headline.fr: Le buffer de pré-rendu des logs ne peut plus déborder
headline.zh: 日志预渲染 buffer 不再溢出
headline.ru: Log pre-render buffer больше не переполняется

what_changed.en: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt subtracts the precomputed instance prefix from the available 4KB capacity, and the Unicode Log overload now supplies its required stack buffer.
what_changed.fr: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt soustrait le préfixe d’instance de la capacité 4 Ko, et l’overload Unicode Log fournit maintenant son buffer stack.
what_changed.zh: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt 从 4KB 可用容量中扣除实例前缀，Unicode Log overload 也会提供所需 stack buffer。
what_changed.ru: TSynLogFamily.PreRenderFmt вычитает prefix instance из доступных 4KB, а Unicode Log overload теперь передаёт required stack buffer.

impact.en: Build 2.4.16999 could write past the stack buffer for an instance-prefixed formatted line near 4KB. Build 2.4.17000 removes that memory-corruption risk and restores Unicode compilation.
impact.fr: Build 2.4.16999 pouvait écrire au-delà du buffer stack pour une ligne proche de 4 Ko avec instance. Build 2.4.17000 supprime ce risque de corruption et rétablit la compilation Unicode.
impact.zh: Build 2.4.16999 对接近 4KB 且带实例前缀的格式化行可能写出 stack buffer；build 2.4.17000 消除该内存破坏风险并恢复 Unicode 编译。
impact.ru: Build 2.4.16999 мог писать за stack buffer для formatted line около 4KB с instance prefix. Build 2.4.17000 устраняет memory corruption risk и восстанавливает Unicode compilation.

action_detail.en: Do not deploy build 2.4.16999. Land on 2.4.17000 or later and test near-4KB formatted lines with a non-nil Instance.
action_detail.fr: Ne déployez pas la build 2.4.16999. Prenez 2.4.17000 ou plus et testez des lignes proches de 4 Ko avec Instance non nil.
action_detail.zh: 不要部署 build 2.4.16999；请采用 2.4.17000 或更高版本，并测试带非 nil Instance 的接近 4KB 格式化行。
action_detail.ru: Не развёртывайте build 2.4.16999. Используйте 2.4.17000 или новее и проверьте formatted lines около 4KB с non-nil Instance.

headline.en: LogView keeps key columns visible and remembers font size
headline.fr: LogView garde les colonnes clés visibles et mémorise la police
headline.zh: LogView 保持关键列可见并记住字体大小
headline.ru: LogView сохраняет ключевые колонки и размер шрифта

what_changed.en: LogView prevents text-column clicks from hiding time, level and thread columns, and adds persistent content font sizing through keys, mouse wheel and menu.
what_changed.fr: LogView empêche la colonne texte de cacher heure, niveau et thread, et ajoute une taille de police persistante par clavier, molette et menu.
what_changed.zh: LogView 防止点击文本列隐藏时间、level 与 thread 列，并通过键盘、滚轮与菜单提供持久化内容字体大小。
what_changed.ru: LogView не позволяет text-column скрывать time, level и thread columns и добавляет persistent font sizing через keys, mouse wheel и menu.

impact.en: Only the Lazarus LogView user interface changes; backend logging and file formats are unaffected.
impact.fr: Seule l’interface Lazarus LogView change ; le backend de log et les formats de fichier ne changent pas.
impact.zh: 仅 Lazarus LogView UI 变化；backend 日志与文件格式不受影响。
impact.ru: Меняется только UI Lazarus LogView; backend logging и file formats не затронуты.

headline.en: Pointer text can be written into any ShortString
headline.fr: Le texte d’un pointeur peut être écrit dans tout ShortString
headline.zh: 指针文本可写入任意 ShortString
headline.ru: Pointer text можно записать в любой ShortString

what_changed.en: mormot.core.text adds PointerToHexShortVar, and PointerToHexShort delegates to it instead of duplicating the pointer-width hexadecimal conversion.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.text ajoute PointerToHexShortVar, et PointerToHexShort lui délègue la conversion hexadécimale.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.text 新增 PointerToHexShortVar，PointerToHexShort 委托给它完成指针宽度十六进制转换。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.text добавляет PointerToHexShortVar, а PointerToHexShort делегирует ему pointer-width hex conversion.

impact.en: Existing callers are unchanged; allocation-free diagnostic code can now fill an existing ShortString variable directly.
impact.fr: Les appelants existants ne changent pas ; le diagnostic sans allocation peut remplir directement un ShortString existant.
impact.zh: 现有调用方不变；无分配诊断代码现在可直接填充现有 ShortString 变量。
impact.ru: Существующие вызовы не меняются; allocation-free diagnostic code может напрямую заполнить существующий ShortString.

note.en: Writes a pointer value into a caller-supplied ShortString.
note.fr: Écrit un pointeur dans un ShortString fourni.
note.zh: 把指针值写入调用方提供的 ShortString。
note.ru: Записывает pointer value в предоставленный ShortString.

headline.en: Short location lookup may omit the hexadecimal fallback
headline.fr: La localisation courte peut omettre le fallback hexadécimal
headline.zh: 短位置查询可省略十六进制 fallback
headline.ru: Short location lookup может убрать hex fallback

what_changed.en: TDebugFile.FindLocationShort adds aNoHex, using PointerToHexShortVar otherwise; the commit also corrects comments and assignment annotations in recent logging code.
what_changed.fr: TDebugFile.FindLocationShort ajoute aNoHex, utilise PointerToHexShortVar sinon, et corrige des commentaires récents du code de log.
what_changed.zh: TDebugFile.FindLocationShort 新增 aNoHex；否则使用 PointerToHexShortVar；同时修正近期日志代码注释与赋值说明。
what_changed.ru: TDebugFile.FindLocationShort добавляет aNoHex, иначе использует PointerToHexShortVar, а также исправляет comments в recent logging code.

impact.en: Diagnostic callers can request an empty result when no debug symbol is found instead of receiving only the address. Existing two-argument calls keep hexadecimal fallback.
impact.fr: Les appelants diagnostic peuvent demander un résultat vide sans symbole. Les appels à deux arguments gardent le fallback hexadécimal.
impact.zh: 诊断调用方可在找不到 debug symbol 时请求空结果，而不是只得到地址；现有双参数调用仍保留十六进制 fallback。
impact.ru: Diagnostic callers могут запросить пустой результат без debug symbol вместо одного адреса. Existing two-argument calls сохраняют hex fallback.

note.zh: 新增可选 aNoHex: boolean = false。
